mentions.name: OpenAltFinder
mentions.description: This website is a directory that helps users discover open source alternatives to software products. It gained traction after Google/Apple Maps renamed Lake Ontario, though the author notes it is still awaiting Google search indexing and relies on active promotion for traffic.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm still working on https://openaltfinder.com; a place to help you discover open source alternatives.
mentions.author: woutr_be

mentions.name: OpenAltFinder
mentions.description: A directory that helps people discover open-source projects, recently expanded with a weekly newsletter and a section for finding beginner friendly issues to contribute to.
mentions.problem: Both Google and Bing completely erased the site from their indexes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm still working on https://openaltfinder.com; a directory to help people discover open-source projects. Added quite a bit of new features over the last month, including a new weekly newsletter, and a way for people to find beginner friendly issues: https://openaltfinder.com/contribute
mentions.author: woutr_be
